title: New user registration
text:
USER STORY
As a user, I would like to be able to register as a new user.

ORIGINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
No acceptance criteria were supplied in the dataset record. Treat this as a useful example of an incomplete story and ask for validation, identity, consent, security, and recovery decisions.

title: Password reset with time limit
text:
USER STORY
As a user, I would like to be able to reset my password.

ORIGINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERION
Validity period 30 minutes, must be communicated.

QUALITY NOTE
The source provides a measurable expiry but leaves identity proof, one-time use, invalidation, privacy-safe responses, rate limiting, auditability, and accessible recovery unresolved.
provenance: Stefan Schwedt (2025), CrUISE-AC data and results, User stories e-commerce.xlsx, Project A, ID 530, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14709846. Verbatim story/criterion plus an explicitly marked Requirements Alchemist quality note.

title: Search autocompletion
text:
USER STORY
As customer, I want to have an autocompletion when I type in the search slot.

ORIGINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Since the shop will have under 1000 titles, a high performance display of the search slot is expected. The appearance of the search slot will work without perceived delay. If I change my search word, the changed search result appears immediately.

QUALITY NOTE
The criteria express intent but use subjective timing. A product-specific measurable latency percentile, trigger length, ordering, empty/error behavior, keyboard behavior, and accessibility semantics remain open.
provenance: Stefan Schwedt (2025), CrUISE-AC data and results, User stories e-commerce.xlsx, Project A, ID 538, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14709846. Verbatim story/criteria plus an explicitly marked Requirements Alchemist quality note.
